name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TLWEGGH15.decodable_support
title: Decodable combinations of path values are supported on valid paths when the gated prefix rows are independent
statement: Over a field K, for each clause k let v k be a linearly independent family indexed by prefixes and L k an injective linear map. If alpha satisfies L k (sum_i [bad k i] alpha_i v k i) = 0 for every k, then alpha_i = 0 whenever bad k i holds for some k.
